question: Câu 601: My cat and my toddler ________ are chasing each other around the living room seem so cheerful.
explanation: that thay thế cụm danh từ gồm cả người và vật.

question: Câu 602: After hiking all day, I ________ exhausted and nearly ________ asleep as soon as I got home.
explanation: felt (cảm thấy) – fell (fall asleep) ở quá khứ đơn.

question: Câu 603: The swimmer was very tired, but he ___________ the shore before he collapsed.
explanation: was able to reach: đã có thể đến được (quá khứ).

question: Câu 604: I believe my brother ___________ the competition since he has been training so hard.
explanation: I believe → will + V (dự đoán chủ quan).

question: Câu 605: Yesterday, they handed out ______ in the square to promote the local charity's fundraising event.
explanation: flyers: tờ rơi.

question: Câu 606: As a teacher, I am always eager to find innovative ways to ______ a love of learning in my students.
explanation: instill: truyền cảm hứng, thấm nhuần.

question: Câu 607: If I had bought the computer, I ______ a computer engineer.
explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 3: would have been.

question: Câu 608: She stopped ______ her favorite show because she lost interest in it.
explanation: stop + V-ing: ngừng làm gì.

question: Câu 609: The manager's feedback included detailed ______ of the team's proposal.
explanation: criticism (n): lời phê bình.

question: Câu 610: When new ideas are introduced, they can often ______ and lead to innovative solutions in the industry.
explanation: come into play: phát huy tác dụng.

question: Câu 611: The report indicated that the resources available for the project were not sufficient to meet the team's goals.
explanation: sufficient = adequate: đầy đủ.

question: Câu 612: The latest prevailing in home decor emphasizes minimalism and natural materials.
explanation: prevailing = trendy: thịnh hành.

question: Câu 613: The research findings suggest that environmental factors can profoundly affect a child's development.
explanation: profoundly >< insignificantly.

question: Câu 614: After much investigation, the detective was able to reveal the true identity of the suspect.
explanation: reveal >< keep secret from.

question: Câu 615: Hạnh: How did your presentation go? Thang: __________
explanation: Trả lời tích cực và lịch sự.

question: Câu 616: Lily: I forgot to bring my notebook to class. Ethan: __________
options: You should buy a new one.
Don't worry, I have an extra.
I don't have time for that.
explanation: Đề nghị giúp đỡ.

question: Câu 617: Nina: Have you ever played tennis before? Leo: No, but __________
options: I'll give it a try someday.
explanation: give it a try: thử.

question: Câu 618: Jake: Would you like me to explain it again, or do you want to figure it out yourself? Mia: __________
options: I don't think it needs any explanation at all.
I'll explain it to you instead.
I'd rather try to figure it out on my own, thanks.
I'm fine with letting it stay unclear.
explanation: Muốn tự tìm hiểu.

question: Câu 619: a. Let's make sure we have enough snacks for everyone. b. I'm planning a small party this weekend. c. That's a good idea—what else do we need? d. Do you think we should get some drinks, too?
explanation: Thứ tự: b-a-c-d.

question: Câu 620: a. It's a good way to make a lasting impression. b. Digital business cards are becoming more popular due to their convenience. c. Why do people exchange business cards during meetings? d. Do people also exchange digital cards now?
explanation: Thứ tự: c-a-d-b.

question: Câu 621: a. You should slow down as it is safe for both you and other drivers. b. I know, I just want to get there quickly. c. Why are you driving so fast? d. I've been in a rush all day, and I'm just trying to catch up. e. You could get into trouble if you keep driving like this. f. I guess you're right. I'll try to be more careful.
explanation: Thứ tự: c-d-e-b-a-f.

question: Câu 622: a. I've been trying to quit smoking, but it's harder than I thought. b. What made you decide to quit smoking? c. Have you considered nicotine patches or gum to help with? d. I've tried many measures to ease the cravings, but they are just so strong. e. That's great! Quitting is tough, but you can do it. f. It's been affecting my health, and I don't want to keep going down this path.
explanation: Thứ tự: a-b-f-e-d-c.

question: Câu 623: Eating breakfast every day is usually more beneficial for your health than skipping it.
options: Omitting breakfast can sometimes be better for your health than consuming it daily.
The more you eat breakfast every day, the healthier you will be.
Eating breakfast is generally better for your health than skipping it.
Eating breakfast is definitely the most advantageous choice for your health.
explanation: Sát nghĩa nhất với so sánh hơn.

question: Câu 624: The presentation was so nerve-wracking that I had to take a moment to calm myself before continuing.
options: The crowd's reaction was so overwhelming that I needed a break to regain my composure.
I had to stop and gather my thoughts during the presentation because I was feeling anxious.
The presentation went smoothly, but I had to take a moment to prepare for the next part.
I felt so nervous presenting in front of the crowd that I had to pause and compose myself.
explanation: so...that + pause and compose myself.

question: Câu 625: Losing weight requires dedication and consistency, though the results are worth the effort.
options: Shedding pounds takes persistence and effort, yet the rewards are great.
Losing weight demands hard work and patience, even if the outcome is satisfying.
Weight loss takes commitment and time, however, the results make it worthwhile.
Dropping weight requires consistent effort, although the benefits are significant.
explanation: commitment and time + however + worthwhile.

question: Câu 626: After failing the entrance exam, the students started practicing more diligently for their next attempt.
options: Hardly had the students received the bad results of their entrance exam when they started practicing diligently for the next one.
No sooner had the students got their failure than they dedicated themselves to intense practice for the next exam.
Provided that the students faced failure in the entrance exam, they immediately began practicing harder.
No matter how hard the students practiced for the entrance exam, they failed it for the next try.
explanation: No sooner...than sát nghĩa nhất.

question: Câu 627: She was uncertain whether to go for a walk or watch a movie. Ultimately, she followed the former.
options: She wavered between going for a walk and watching a movie, then she chose the second option.
She preferred going for a walk after being uncertain between two options.
She would prefer to watch a movie instead of going for a walk.
After being uncertain, she decided to go for a walk rather than watch a movie.
explanation: the former = go for a walk.

question: Câu 628: The train is fully boarded. It is scheduled to leave in a few minutes.
options: The train will leave shortly as everyone is on board.
Although the train is boarded, it might still take some time to depart.
The train is fully boarded, so it will stay longer at the station.
The train schedule depends on when passengers finish boarding.
explanation: will leave shortly as everyone is on board.

question: Câu 629: Due to a scheduling conflict, the interview was postponed. Candidates were asked to wait in the lobby until the room became available.
options: The interview was rescheduled due to a scheduling issue, because candidates were asked to wait in the lobby until the interview room was ready.
A scheduling conflict caused a delay in the interview, though candidates had to wait in the lobby until the interview room was available.
The interview was postponed as a result of a scheduling issue, requiring candidates to wait in the lobby until the room had been prepared.
In case of a scheduling conflict, candidates would have waited in the lobby until the room became available.
explanation: postponed as a result of + requiring candidates to wait.

question: Câu 630: Years of dedicated practice led her to become the lead singer of the band. Her success was also the result of her perseverance.
options: Her consistent practice and determination over the years helped her rise to the position of lead singer in the band.
Her years of practice and perseverance could be attributed to her success in becoming the band's lead singer.
Through her perseverance, which stemmed from years of dedicated practice, she became the lead singer of the band.
Her perseverance and years of practice made her the lead singer of the band, resulting in her success.
explanation: consistent practice and determination → lead singer.

question: Câu 631: ...too much exercise can do just as much (631)________.
explanation: do damage: gây thiệt hại.

question: Câu 632: Although it is true that moderate exercise such as walking can be very beneficial to a person's health, (632)________.
options: it not only keeps us healthy by this factor
it is not the only factor which keeps us healthy
there is only one way to keep us healthy
health can be maintained by just only one factor
explanation: không phải yếu tố duy nhất.

question: Câu 633: However, (633)________. So people are urged to take moderate exercise...
options: too much exercise can also cause problems
exercising too little can also cause problems
problems result in many extreme exercising
the problems of exercising too much
explanation: too much exercise can also cause problems.

question: Câu 634: ...eating healthy food does not have to cost a (634)________...
explanation: cost a fortune: đắt đỏ.

question: Câu 635: People need better (635) ________ about their health.
explanation: need + V-ing (bị động).

question: Câu 636: What is mentioned about TikTok according to the first paragraph?
options: TikTok has become one of the fastest-growing apps since its launch.
TikTok's core audience primarily consists of users aged 25 and above.
TikTok has fewer downloads than Instagram since its inception.
TikTok's audience is ageing, similar to Facebook and Instagram.
explanation: one of the fastest growing apps since it was first launched in 2016.

question: Câu 637: What is the word “frivolous” in paragraph 2 closest in meaning to?
explanation: frivolous = joking / vui vẻ, hài hước.

question: Câu 638: What challenge do brands face when using TikTok for marketing?
options: TikTok's user base is too small to justify marketing efforts.
Brands find it hard to reimage their style of videos.
TikTok's video style is less extensive compared to other platforms.
TikTok does not allow brands to create official accounts.
explanation: less expansive and flexible formats.

question: Câu 639: Why does the author mention the Met in the third paragraph?
options: To demonstrate how traditional institutions struggle to adapt to modern social platforms.
To show how The Met pioneered creative use of TikTok to engage a young audience.
To emphasize the limitations of TikTok's video style for serious organizations.
To highlight TikTok's role in reshaping how organizations connect with global users.
explanation: trailblazer in creating content to engage the app's young audience.

question: Câu 640: Which of the following does the author most likely support?
options: Tiktok can be a challenge to museums but can't be still handled.
The pandemic had a significant impact on TikTok's audience behaviors.
TikTok helps museums connect with a growing global audience.
TikTok primarily benefits museums by generating direct revenue.
explanation: reaching new audiences... global explosion of users.

question: Câu 641: What is the passage mainly about?
options: There is controversy over using testing to assess learners' abilities.
Testing is considered the perfect method.
Taking IELTS or TOEFL tests is a must.
Some types of evaluation are used to assess students' abilities.
explanation: educators are divided... The debate on testing continues.

question: Câu 642: What does the word “they” in paragraph 3 refer to?
explanation: people trying to reform this system. They believe...

question: Câu 643: Which of the following would reformers NOT agree with?
options: Multiple-choice tests are not a good way to evaluate intelligence.
It is important to see how students communicate with other people.
Writing and speaking tests seem to assess students' abilities more precisely.
A good test should allow examiners to easily compare people.
explanation: Reformers tin standard tests không phải cách tốt nhất để so sánh.

question: Câu 644: According to the passage, what point is illustrated by the mention of Montessori and Waldorf schools?
options: There is no need to test student's abilities.
Students gain knowledge by taking part in activities.
New test methods will continue to develop.
explanation: focus is on learning by experiencing and doing things.

question: Câu 645: What can be inferred from the last paragraph?
options: Educationists have invented a perfect method to assess students' performance.
Discussions on testing methods are still ongoing among educators.
Various methods of evaluation have already been confirmed.
Educators take responsibilities for testing students' abilities.
explanation: The debate on testing continues...

question: Câu 646: You accidentally missed an important meeting at work, and your manager is disappointed. Which of the following is the most appropriate response?
options: I didn't think it was that important, so I skipped it.
I'm sorry for missing the meeting. I was too busy handling something else.
I apologize for missing the meeting and never let it happen again. I will review the notes to catch up.
I'm so sorry for forgetting. I just couldn't manage my schedule properly this time.
explanation: Xin lỗi + cam kết không tái phạm + hành động khắc phục.

question: Câu 647: You need to adjust your work schedule for a personal appointment, and your supervisor, Taylor, values clear communication. Which of the following is the most appropriate way to ask for approval?
options: I'll be leaving early today, but don't worry; I'll handle anything urgent tomorrow.
Could I leave early today for a personal matter? I'll ensure my tasks are completed before I go.
I have an appointment and need to leave early today. Apologies for not informing you sooner.
I'm stepping out early today. Let me know if you have concerns.
explanation: Xin phép lịch sự + đảm bảo hoàn thành công việc.

question: Câu 648: From the figure given below, determine the number of students who did not study any of the two subjects.
Câu 649: A Tiebreaker is an additional contest carried out to establish a winner among tied contestants. Choose one situation from the options below that best represents a Tiebreaker.
options: At halftime, the score is tied at 2-2 in a football match.
Serena and Maria have each secured 1 set in the game.
The umpire tosses a coin to decide which team will have a bat first.
RCB and KKR each finished at 140 all out.
explanation: Cùng điểm → cần tiebreaker để phân thắng thua.

question: Câu 650: At the airport, your luggage is scanned by a machine. What is the most likely explanation for how the machine examines your belongings?
options: The machine uses X-rays to create images of the contents of your luggage by detecting how different materials absorb the rays.
The machine emits ultraviolet light that reacts with specific items in your luggage to identify their presence.
Infrared waves are sent through your luggage to measure heat signatures of the items inside.
The machine uses sound waves to create a map of the contents of your luggage, similar to an ultrasound.
explanation: Máy quét sân bay dùng tia X.
